risk_note: RV2 (platform/queue, platform/config, platform/platform.module.ts). Worker queue concurrency (architecture review R-07, D10-183 ③): the worker's 17 queues have 38 plan slots against a 10-connection business pool. Per-queue overrides QUEUE_CONCURRENCY_<queue> may only lower a queue's plan concurrency; a shared budget QUEUE_DB_BUDGET (default 7, at most 7) of running jobs is taken before fetching and released only after the handler exits (also when it overruns its lease), released at once on an empty fetch or a fetch error; jobs over the budget stay unclaimed with no retry counted; the dead-letter scan takes no permit. Only the worker entry is affected, and only when an override is set. QueueSpec / WorkSpec fields, ENTRY_PLAN defaults and QUEUE_CATALOG pinned by frozen tests are unchanged; the worker plan, default budget and config types moved to a dependency-free queue/worker-plan.ts to break a config → queue → logging → config cycle. Codex was unavailable until 10-30, so tests and reviews ran on fresh independent Claude contexts (approvals id 36).
